directive: Revise oeq:certified-implementation to fix an explicit IEEE-754 or equivalent directed-rounding model; specify bounded exact input encoding and bit complexity, overflow/subnormal handling, and certified polynomial-time outward enclosures for normal and chi-square quantiles. Add the rank-one joint-zero certificate target showing all numerical padding is o(n^{-1}); preserve the statistical theorem suite and its field-level scope unchanged.

Repair oeq:certified-implementation by separating (i) a deterministic theorem for exact-dyadic encoded inputs and directed arithmetic from (ii) the continuous Gaussian statistical experiment. Define an explicit measurable observation-encoding/rounding map from real Gaussian blocks to dyadic data at precision p_n, propagate its deterministic encoding error into Delta_num, and state all P-probability and P-expectation claims for the composed encoded procedure. Retain overflow/subnormal and uncertain-gate safeguards and the joint-zero o(n^{-1}) budget; do not impose an exact-dyadic assumption on the Gaussian draws. Preserve the statistical theorem suite and field-level scope.
